params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Morgana''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for 18% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt by her {{tip|abilities}} against {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}}, and medium and large {{tip|monsters}}.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Morgana}} {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for a portion of the damage dealt by her abilities against {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}}, and medium and large {{tip|monsters}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' throws a sphere of dark magic in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Morgana}} throws a sphere of dark magic in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a "short time".

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''Tormented Shadow's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 5% of its '''total''' cooldown whenever ''{{ai|Soul Siphon|Morgana}}'' triggers. Simultaneous triggers from multiple targets will stack the cooldown reduction.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' torments the soil at the target location, causing the area to become desecrated for 5 seconds. Enemies within take {{as|magic damage}} on-cast and every {{fd|0.5}} seconds thereafter, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}. ''Tormented Shadow'' deals 170% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Minimum Damage Per Tick|{{ap|9 to 35}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Maximum Damage Per Tick|{{ap|9*2 to 35*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Damage|{{ap|9*10 to 35*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*10}}% AP)}}|Maximum Total Damage|{{ap|9*10*2 to 35*10*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*10*2}}% AP)}}}}
params.notes: * Damage from multiple ''Tormented Shadows'' does not stack.
params.tips:
* The interaction with ''{{ai|Soul Siphon|Morgana}}'' does not exclude ''Tormented Shadow's'' damage, which means it can effectively reduce its own cooldown.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''Tormented Shadow's'' '''current''' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} whenever ''{{ai|Soul Siphon|Morgana}}'' triggers.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Morgana}} desecrates the target area for a few seconds, which continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied {{tip|champion}} or herself for 5 seconds, which absorbs incoming {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} while it holds.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Morgana}} {{tip|shields}} the target allied champion or herself for a few seconds, which absorbs {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} while the shield holds.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions over the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and forming a {{tip|tether}} between herself and each target for 3 seconds, during which she gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and the targets are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20%.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 350}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 350*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80*2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
params.description2: If a target does not break their tether by the end of its duration, they are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} again and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
params.description3: ''An enemy champion within {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 575 units is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be tethered by this ability.''
params.notes: * {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied. * '''Morgana''' will turn to face southeast upon casting ''Soul Shackles''. * ''Soul Shackles'' checks for nearby valid targets around a location that is '''Morgana's''' exact location at the start of the cast time. ** In other words, the latch-on radius is from a fixed location around ''Soul Shackles' '' cast point in which targets are acquired; targets around '''Morgana's''' location at the end of the cast time that are not within this radius will not be targeted, since her location after the cast starts is not considered. *** Enemies that were outside of the latch-on radius at the time of cast that enter it afterwards, during the cast time, will be targeted. * A circle indicator for Soul Shackles' maximum tether range is visible to '''Morgana''' and her tethered targets only.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Morgana}} latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and forming a {{tip|tether}} between herself and each target for a short time, during which the targets are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}, and '''Morgana''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.blurb2: If a target maintains the tether after its duration, they are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} and become briefly {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}}.
